programs.title: The 90-Day Bowel Control Program
programs.subtitle: Build better urge control, pelvic-floor timing, and everyday confidence.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Learn the gentle lift used for control and the full release needed for easier emptying.

days.title: Closure and Release
days.intention: Practice a gentle lift for closure, then release fully so the muscles can work in both directions. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Build the Support Team
days.intention: Train your hips and deep abdominal muscles to share the work around your pelvis. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Exhale Before Effort
days.intention: Breathe out during effort so you can manage pressure without bearing down or straining. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Make Control Last
days.intention: Practice steady pelvic-floor control, followed by a complete release between repetitions. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Calm the Urge
days.intention: Bring your timing into standing, walking, and the first moments of a bowel urge. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Ready for Real Life
days.intention: Add useful strength for bowel and gas control without clenching all day. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.

days.title: Control Reset
days.intention: Use slower movement and easy breathing to practice full release without straining. Use gentle effort. Control needs a clean lift and a complete release.
